transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Let's get our package-lock meeting started. We have a worldwide 68-minute master due to the streaming platform this Friday. Before I can authorize delivery, I need to review four items with each of you: release territory, running time, credits, and approval requirements. The documentary is currently assembled at 68 minutes and has not yet been publicly released. I'd like each of the three responsible production leads to report on their area and flag any outstanding requirements. Once all three of you have responded, I'll issue the formal settlement action and authorization decision right here in this meeting. Who'd like to go first?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical issue. I reviewed the executed music license this morning, and the featured song permits digital streaming only in the United States and Canada — not worldwide. Additionally, the license requires a cue sheet to be delivered with the authorized master. I have not yet entered these limits in the release tracker, so the tracker does not currently reflect these restrictions.
